status: Sizing experiment against the current v0.2 schema; not a full-quota or retention test
method: Two isolated temporary SQLite databases, each with 8,000 validated protocol-v2 snapshots across four replicas; all configured routes active, HTTP body sizes and periodic short events; actual SQLiteStore ingestion with WAL; checkpointed before measuring the DB/WAL/SHM family; integrity and foreign-key checks passed. No live runtime was modified.
limitations: Synthetic schema sizing only; not a throughput benchmark.
Retention projections exclude extra storage for future host metrics, rollups and retention bookkeeping.
No 5 GiB volume was allocated, and circular retention is not implemented.
Actual filesystem space, memory pressure, WAL peaks and query performance require runtime validation.
